description: Compare finite-pulse diffusion and effective exponential polarization relaxation using the same early voltage anchors. Complete later rest blocks remain held out.
domain: battery diagnostics and laboratory data integration
independent_unit: Last 20% of qualifying rest groups by acquisition chronology remain test. Whole development groups use historical compact-v2 canonical hash allocation; this is interleaved development, not forward-only validation.
limitations: Known relaxation families conditional on 60/120-second observations
Single half-cell and chronological held-out rest blocks; no independent-cell validation
No diffusion coefficient or unique electrochemical mechanism is identified
Semi-infinite diffusion approximation; finite-particle and multiple-process deviations retained
title: Diffusion and polarization during battery rest
